paths.description: Homepage catalogue, global navigation, consent, preferences, mobile reflow, performance, privacy, accessibility, and memory. Represents the primary listing template.
Category index, representing taxonomy/listing navigation and dense card layout.
Representative video detail and legally required UK age-gated playback state; represents media-detail pages.

Signup/account entry modal, representing the account journey and disclosure state. Identity verification and authenticated account management were not covered because they require personal/legal credentials.
Indonesian and Arabic home variants, representing translated and RTL rendering.

findings.summary: Animations continue when reduced motion is requested.
findings.evidence: The reduced-motion evaluate probe reported eight running animations, each with a 2000 ms duration and infinite iterations, while prefers-reduced-motion: reduce matched; loaded CSS contained no reduced-motion media query.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a prefers-reduced-motion: reduce override that removes non-essential looping animation and shortens necessary state transitions.

findings.summary: Page and state changes do not use View Transitions.
findings.evidence: The CSS/platform probe found no view-transition rules or names; navigation is conventional multi-page replacement.
findings.suggestedFix: Progressively enhance same-origin navigation and substantial state swaps with View Transitions, retaining an instant fallback under reduced motion.

findings.summary: Persistent chrome does not react to scroll state.
findings.evidence: Desktop and long category screenshots show fixed, space-heavy navigation; the CSS probe found no scroll-state container queries or scroll-timeline support.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce persistent chrome as content scrolls and use a progressive scroll-state/container-query treatment where browser support permits.

findings.summary: A large consent modal obscures the primary content on every fresh visit.
findings.evidence: Homepage, categories, detail, and signup screenshots all open with a 525x380 centered consent surface covering the core viewport, before interaction.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a less obstructive consent surface where legally possible, retain equally prominent Accept and Reject actions, and remember the choice reliably.

findings.summary: Modal UI is built from generic divs rather than the native dialog primitive.
findings.evidence: The platform probe found zero dialog, popover, or details elements; signup uses a DIV with role=dialog and aria-modal=true.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a native dialog for modal account and consent flows, with showModal(), focus containment, Escape handling, and explicit labelling.

findings.summary: The desktop layout is forced into a 360 px mobile viewport.
findings.evidence: At viewport 360x800, layout measured scrollWidth 1024 versus clientWidth 360 and 664 px horizontal overflow; the screenshot shows a cropped desktop sidebar and content grid.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove the 1024 px minimum layout, make navigation and cards intrinsically responsive, and validate no horizontal overflow at narrow widths.

findings.summary: Components rely on a desktop-sized global layout rather than adapting to their container.
findings.evidence: The CSS probe found no @container or container-type rules, and the 360 px capture retained the 1024 px desktop composition.
findings.suggestedFix: Introduce container queries for reusable navigation, card grids, and banners while preserving fluid intrinsic fallbacks.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus is invisible on key controls.
findings.evidence: The focus probe programmatically focused Search, Login, Get started, the promo action, and an icon button; computed outline was none/0 px and no compensating box shadow appeared on most controls.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide a high-contrast :focus-visible ring on every interactive element and verify the full keyboard path.

findings.summary: Synthetic LCP misses the good threshold.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse mobile measured LCP 2.9 s and FCP 2.8 s; the independent trace measured LCP 2.25 s, indicating a borderline experience dependent on conditions.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritise the actual LCP element, reduce document response delay, and defer non-critical UI and scripts.

findings.summary: The initial route has a broad resource and blocking surface.
findings.evidence: HAR recorded 143 requests and 1.80 MB transferred, including 11 stylesheets and 61 scripts; three parser-inserted high-priority stylesheets were confirmed as media=all.
findings.suggestedFix: Consolidate critical CSS, defer route-specific styles and dependencies, and reduce the initial request fan-out.

findings.summary: The initial page ships unused CSS and JavaScript.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimated 57 KiB unused CSS (87-95% unused in two files) and 26 KiB unused JavaScript; HAR shows one index script alone transferred 402 KB.
findings.suggestedFix: Split bundles by route and component, load below-fold features on demand, and remove CSS not needed for the initial viewport.

findings.summary: Several controls have missing or invalid accessible semantics.
findings.evidence: axe reported a critical unnamed button, an unnamed role=button video item, prohibited aria-label use, nested interactive controls, and focusable content inside aria-hidden.
findings.suggestedFix: Give every control a stable accessible name, use native button/link elements, remove nested controls, and make hidden panels inert.

findings.summary: Important text fails WCAG AA contrast.
findings.evidence: axe measured ratios as low as 1.75:1 on the age-verification subtitle, 2.15:1 on its heading, 3.29:1 for view counts, and 4.04:1 for signup text.
findings.suggestedFix: Adjust foreground/background design tokens to meet at least 4.5:1 for normal text and 3:1 for large text and essential UI.

findings.summary: Landmark and focus management are not consistently accessible.
findings.evidence: axe found duplicate/unlabelled landmarks, nested complementary landmarks, and focusable descendants inside aria-hidden; the focus probe found several controls with no visible focus indicator.
findings.suggestedFix: Label repeated landmarks, keep asides top-level, make hidden regions inert, and establish a visible logical focus path.

findings.summary: Narrow-screen reflow is unusable without horizontal panning.
findings.evidence: The 360 px viewport retained a 1024 px layout and overflowed by 664 px despite a valid viewport meta tag.
findings.suggestedFix: Support WCAG reflow by allowing the page to collapse to one column without horizontal scrolling, then retest at 320-360 px and 400% zoom.

findings.summary: Rich video pages omit structured data and social preview metadata.
findings.evidence: The representative video page had no JSON-LD, and the homepage resource probe found no Open Graph or Twitter metadata; title, H1, description, and canonical were otherwise present.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate VideoObject JSON-LD and Open Graph/Twitter metadata that matches the visible title, description, thumbnail, duration, and canonical URL.

findings.summary: The CSP is too narrow and two first-party cookies are not Secure.
findings.evidence: Headers reported CSP only as frame-ancestors 'self', without script/style/default restrictions. Cookies reported x_csrf_token and settings without Secure; settings also uses SameSite=None.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a nonce/hash-based CSP with default-src and script-src protections, and set Secure plus an appropriate SameSite value on every HTTPS cookie.

findings.summary: Several browser-enforced defenses are missing or under-scoped.
findings.evidence: The headers probe found no X-Content-Type-Options and no response Referrer-Policy; Permissions-Policy only declared two UA client-hint features, while the document itself requests unsafe-url referrer behavior.
findings.suggestedFix: Set nosniff, a privacy-preserving Referrer-Policy, a least-privilege Permissions-Policy, and expand CSP beyond clickjacking protection.

findings.summary: Many images are oversized or lack intrinsic sizing and modern delivery hints.
findings.evidence: The images primitive found 29 of 36 images without width/height attributes, 13 oversized images, 15 legacy-format images, 8 below-fold images without lazy loading, and 3 without responsive sources.
findings.suggestedFix: Reserve image space, request sizes close to display dimensions, use modern formats and srcset/sizes, and lazy-load non-critical below-fold imagery.

taskList.title: Make the site genuinely reflow at narrow widths and zoom
Repair accessible names, landmarks, hidden-state focus, focus rings, and contrast
Strengthen CSP, cookie flags, and defensive response policies
Reduce initial bundles, blocking styles, and request fan-out
Replace custom blocking overlays with semantic, less intrusive dialogs
Respect reduced motion and progressively enhance navigation transitions
Add rich video metadata and optimise image delivery
